items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he had a nickname they called him “Juve Baby” I guess because he was light skinned

ctx.x: Was there a drummer in the band?

Oh yeah his name was—they call him-- he had a nickname they called him “Juve Baby” I guess because he was light skinned (laughs) you know back then everybody had a nickname. (Laughs) You know at first I didn’t know what that meant I said’ what kind of word is that!?”
About how old were you EJ:I was 10 or 12 I was still in grade school
